ai: She is a disciplined worker who never misses a deadline.
她是個很自律的員工，從不錯過截止期限。
The team stayed disciplined throughout the long project.
整個漫長的專案中，團隊始終保持紀律。
We are looking for an experienced accountant.
我們正在找一位有經驗的會計師。
The experienced manager handled the crisis calmly.
那位經驗豐富的經理冷靜地處理了危機。
Please send your curriculum vitae to the HR department.
請將你的履歷寄給人事部。
Her curriculum vitae lists ten years of teaching experience.
她的履歷上列有十年的教學經驗。
The visitors stood in reverent silence at the memorial.
訪客們在紀念碑前恭敬地肅立默哀。
He spoke of his old teacher in a reverent tone.
他用恭敬的語氣談起他的老師。
Sales numbers are not the only yardstick of success.
銷售數字不是衡量成功的唯一標準。
The company uses customer feedback as a yardstick for service quality.
公司把顧客回饋當作服務品質的評價標準。
There was a commotion outside the office when the fire alarm went off.
火災警報響起時，辦公室外一陣騷動。
What's all the commotion about?
大家在吵什麼？
Her most noteworthy achievement was doubling the company's sales.
她最值得一提的成就是讓公司的銷售額翻倍。
Nothing noteworthy happened at the meeting.
這次會議沒有發生什麼值得注意的事。
He was oblivious to the problems in his team.
他完全沒察覺到團隊裡的問題。
She walked on, oblivious of the rain.
她繼續往前走，渾然不覺下雨了。
Make sure you look presentable for the job interview.
去面試時一定要穿得體面一點。
The office was tidied up to make it presentable for visitors.
辦公室整理過了，好讓訪客看了覺得體面。
Wages have remained stagnant for several years.
薪資已經停滯了好幾年。
The stagnant economy made it hard to find a job.
經濟不景氣讓人很難找到工作。
Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.
蚊子會在不流動的積水中繁殖。
Open the window; the air in here is stagnant.
開個窗吧，這裡的空氣都不流通。

self-explanatory.zh: 不言自明的、一看就懂的
ai: The instructions are self-explanatory, so you won't need any help.
說明一看就懂，所以你不需要別人幫忙。
Most of the items on the form are self-explanatory.
表格上大部分項目都不用解釋就看得懂。
The parsimonious boss refused to buy new chairs for the staff.
那個吝嗇的老闆不肯為員工買新椅子。
He was too parsimonious to give his workers a bonus.
他太小氣了，不肯發獎金給員工。
Her quick wit made her a popular speaker.
她反應敏捷又風趣，因此是很受歡迎的講者。
He answered every question with humor and wit.
他用幽默和機智回答每個問題。

wit.zh: 智力、頭腦（常用 at one's wit's end：束手無策）

ai: Only the hardy workers stayed on the farm through the winter.
只有吃苦耐勞的工人留在農場過冬。
These hardy plants can survive very cold weather.
這些耐寒的植物能在非常寒冷的天氣中存活。
The hotel is renowned for its excellent service.
這家飯店以優質服務聞名。
She was trained by a renowned chef in Paris.
她曾在巴黎接受一位知名主廚的指導。
Working for a famous company brings a certain prestige.
在知名公司工作會帶來一定的聲望。
The award greatly increased the school's prestige.
這個獎大幅提升了學校的聲望。
The factory shutdown left 300 people without jobs.
工廠停工讓三百人失業。
The system will be down during the planned shutdown on Sunday.
週日預定停機期間，系統將無法使用。
Filling out all these forms is such a hassle.
填這些表格真是麻煩。
Online booking saves you the hassle of waiting in line.
線上預約可以免去排隊的麻煩。
The company rewards employees for their fidelity and long service.
公司獎勵員工的忠誠與長期服務。
They promised fidelity to each other at their wedding.
他們在婚禮上承諾彼此忠誠。

fidelity.zh: （翻譯、音質等的）準確度、保真度
ai: The translation was praised for its fidelity to the original.
這份譯文因忠於原文而受到稱讚。
These speakers offer high fidelity sound.
這組喇叭提供高傳真的音質。
The workers made a plea for better working conditions.
工人們懇求改善工作環境。
Her plea for help was ignored.
她的求救沒有人理會。

plea.zh: （法律上的）答辯、認罪與否的聲明
ai: He entered a plea of not guilty.
他提出無罪答辯。
The court accepted her guilty plea.
法院接受了她的認罪答辯。
HR staff must be discreet about employees' personal information.
人事人員對員工的個人資料必須謹慎保密。
He made a discreet phone call during the meeting.
他在會議中低調地打了一通電話。
She gave a thoughtful answer to the difficult question.
她對那個難題給出了深思熟慮的回答。
He looked thoughtful for a moment before he spoke.
他若有所思了一會兒才開口。
Attention to detail is the hallmark of a good editor.
注重細節是好編輯的特徵。
Friendly service has become the hallmark of the hotel.
親切的服務已成為這家飯店的招牌。
Our company motto is "Customers come first."
我們公司的座右銘是「顧客至上」。
His motto in life is to never give up.
他的人生座右銘是永不放棄。
